title_ar: تلفزيون قطر يستضيف الشيخ في برنامج حياة القلوب
title_en: Qatar Television Hosts the Sheikh on the Programme "Life of the Hearts"
body_ar: استضافت تلفزيون قطر أمس الجمعة فضيلة العلامة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في برنامج "حياة القلوب" في الساعة العاشرة صباحا في موضوع: "مقومات الشخصية الإسلامية المعاصرة". وقد تحدث الشيخ في موضوع: "مقومات الشخصية الإسلامية المعاصرة" عن مفهوم المقومات وحاجة الإنسان إلى تنمية القدرات الطبيعية الثلاث: الروح والجسم والعقل، وبين أن الإسلام رتب لكل نوع من هذه القدرات خطابا يتماشا وينسجم مع فطرة الإنسان ويحقق له كل المصالح والرغبات النافعة له دنيا وأخرى. كما ركز فضيلته على أن مقومات الشخصية المسلمة لا ينالها الإنسان إلا ببناء مراحل أربعة ضرورية: 1- طلب العلم. 2 - العمل بما تعلمه. 3 - الدعوة. 4 - الصبر على طريق الحق. وهذه المقومات الأربع هي مصداق لقول الله تعالى في سورة العصر: " وَالْعَصْرِ (1) إِنَّ الإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ (2) إِلاَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ (3). وذكر فضيلته أن الشخصية المسلمة النموذجية هي التي جعلها الله سبحانه وتعالى قدوة للبشر وأمرنا باتباعها؛ وهي المتمثلة في شخص النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سمتا ومنهجا.
body_en: Qatar Television hosted his eminence the erudite Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew yesterday, Friday, on the programme "Life of the Hearts" at ten in the morning, on the subject: "The Constituents of the Contemporary Islamic Personality". The Sheikh spoke on the subject "The Constituents of the Contemporary Islamic Personality", on the concept of constituents and on the human being's need to develop the three natural capacities: spirit, body and intellect. He explained that Islam has set out for each kind of these capacities a mode of address that goes along and accords with the innate human disposition (fiṭrah) and that secures for him every benefit and every desire that profits him in this world and the next. His eminence also stressed that the constituents of the Muslim personality are attained only by building four necessary stages: 1 — seeking knowledge; 2 — acting upon what one has learned; 3 — calling people to Islam (daʿwah); 4 — patience upon the path of truth. These four constituents are the embodiment of the words of God Most High in Sūrat al-ʿAṣr: {By Time. Truly man is in loss, save those who believe and do righteous deeds, and enjoin one another to truth, and enjoin one another to patience.} (Sūrat al-ʿAṣr 103:1–3). His eminence mentioned that the exemplary Muslim personality is the one God — glorified and exalted is He — has made a model for humankind and commanded us to follow, and that it is embodied in the person of the Prophet — may God bless him and grant him peace — in bearing and in method.

flags.note: fiṭrah is listed in style guide section 13 as a glossary addition still pending; flagged rather than fixed. 'The innate human disposition' is used here provisionally and should be harmonised corpus-wide once the term is settled.

translator_notes: This is a site news notice reporting a television appearance, not a text by the Sheikh. Everything attributed to him is the site editor's summary of what he said on air; the English keeps that reporting frame throughout ('he explained', 'his eminence stressed') so that no sentence reads as his own written words.
The Qur'anic rendering is interpretive and is not a substitute for the Arabic.

The page ends with a navigation line, 'To watch the lecture click here', linking to the recording in the site's separate media system. It is a site affordance rather than content and has been left out of the body; the recording itself is out of scope for text translation.
The CMS date, Saturday 8 January 2011, is consistent with the text's 'yesterday, Friday'.
